method.near_duplicate: 63-bit DCT thumbnail Hamming <= 4 AND 32x32 RGB mean absolute difference <= 0.035
method.crop_scope: FGSRCS known-box crops use 10% context, so crop-level matches approximate same-ship/same-scene overlap but are not proof of identical source scenes

limitations: Global thumbnails cannot detect crops, rotations, re-scaling or heavy reprocessing.
No port, capture-time or vessel identity is available for either release; a negative screen does not establish scene or port independence.
Crop-level near-duplicates are expected when the same ship appears in both datasets and do not by themselves prove shared source imagery.
